description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendments, Kamburugamuwa North, Weligama D/S Division, Matara District - Cad. Map No. 820069
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains multiple entries correcting and updating specific land parcel details including cadastral map numbers, land extents, and servitude rights for various properties across different districts. The content is purely land and property-related, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) as it involves land title registrations, property boundary adjustments, and land record amendments without any government personnel changes or structural administrative matters.
